source.notes: The Authorization header was redacted at capture time; the X-CSRF-Token header was redacted by the transcriber before this cassette was written. POST /sap/bc/adt/repository/nodestructure against ZAPI_ENABLEMENT, a package with no contents. The response is HTTP 200 with a genuinely zero-byte body (content-length: 0) and no content-type header — NOT an empty XML document and not a 404. A reader must treat this as a distinct, valid outcome rather than a parse failure. Confirmed as real server behaviour (not a harness artifact) by the sibling captures 877/878/879 (same shape, different empty packages) and by the control capture 880 (same code path against a non-empty package returns the full body).
